mechanism: Blend three independent Hurst estimators (classical R/S, aggregated variance, absolute moments) into a confidence-weighted composite H; map H>0.60 (conf≥0.30) to persistent/trend-following, H<0.40 to anti-persistent/mean-reversion, and 0.40–0.60 as a no-trade transition band. Confidence is valid log-log scale count / max scales; estimators below conf threshold are dropped from the blend.
data_needed: Session-scoped M1 log-returns (filter |r|≥0.1 artifacts); bars_since_open only after NY open reset
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ front-month Globex futures M1 (133 sessions Nov 2025–May 2026); also US100 M1 referenced; HurstProfile.mq5 on any M1 chart
why_new_for_mis: MIS can treat multi-estimator agreement as a regime reliability gate rather than a single Hurst number, and use the 0.4–0.6 dead band as an explicit no-directional-bias sensor on equity-index M1.
quote: A reading becomes meaningful only when it departs from that band in a sustained way. A composite H above 0.60 with confidence above 0.30 indicates that the market is operating with positive long-range autocorrelation

mechanism: Force Hurst (and later fractal) windows to reset at the session open so pre-open thin overnight bars are never mixed with post-open institutional flow; contaminated windows at 09:33 ET produced H≈0.37 vs true post-open baseline ~0.46–0.50 — an artifact, not a regime flip.
data_needed: Session open timestamp (09:30 ET NY); count of bars elapsed since open as the period argument
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 Globex; NY session 09:30–16:00 ET
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit session-break detector/guard: treat open-boundary window contamination as a measurement-change event that invalidates rolling long-memory sensors until warmup (≈40 bars).
quote: Without a session reset, the rolling window at 09:33 ET contains 86 pre-open bars and only 4 open bars. Mean H in this contaminated window drops to 0.37—0.09 points below the true post-open baseline.

mechanism: Estimate fractional differencing parameter d via Geweke–Porter–Hudak log-periodogram OLS on the first m=floor(N^0.65) Fourier frequencies; confidence = regression R². Flag sessions where |H − (d+0.5)| > 0.1 as short-memory bias or session mixing. Operational bands: d∈(−0.1,0.1) near RW; d>0.1 persistent; d<−0.1 anti-persistent.
data_needed: Validated log-return array; prior Hurst fields for consistency; GPH bandwidth/min-freq constants
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: US100 M1 Globex, 72 NY sessions Jan–May 2026 (pooled d=−0.006, session σ_d=0.153)
why_new_for_mis: Pairs two independent long-memory sensors (H and d) so MIS can sense regime disagreement as a diagnostic of short-range contamination rather than trusting either alone.
quote: If they diverge by more than 0.1—the threshold encoded in GPH_D_CONSISTENCY—the inconsistency is flagged in result.validation_message for investigation.

mechanism: MFDFA with Legendre-transform spectrum width Δα=α_max−α_min and mean R² confidence; narrow Δα means H/d are reliable monofractal descriptors, wide Δα (>~0.99 on NQ) means opposing memory regimes cancel in averages — prefer FIGARCH-inspired proxy over H/d.
data_needed: ≥100 filtered log-returns; geometric scales from 16 to N/4; q in [−5,5]; reject if mean R²<0.65
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures M1, 514 NY sessions May 2024–May 2026 (median Δα=0.875)
why_new_for_mis: Turns multifractal width into a meta-sensor that tells MIS when average long-memory stats are unreliable mixtures rather than true random-walk absence.
quote: A narrow Δα (< 0.3) means H and d are reliable descriptors. A wide Δα (> 0.5) means the series contains opposing memory regimes that cancel in the average.

mechanism: Populate realized, session-duration-annualized, GPH-d-weighted FractionalVolatility, Baillie fractional-kernel FIGARCH proxy (bipower baseline), lag-1 squared-return ClusteringIndex, GJR-GARCH γ/(α+γ+β) leverage, and bipower 3σ JumpIntensity; select which vol estimate to size with by Δα and clustering (FIGARCH if extreme mixing; fractional if clustering>0.20; else RV).
data_needed: M1 closes; optional Dube GJR library; GPH d; NY session seconds 23400 for M1 annualization
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 futures, 514 NY sessions; stress episodes BoJ Aug 2024, Fed Dec 2024, tariff Apr 2025/2026
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a regime-conditioned volatility stack (level, persistence, asymmetry, jumps) instead of a single ATR, including the finding that clustering can weaken in acute stress.
quote: the clustering index is lower during acute stress regimes (0.107 for the tariff shock vs 0.147 for normal sessions). During acute stress, volatility becomes more erratic and less predictable bar-to-bar, not more clustered.

mechanism: Three-component OHLC noise ratio: 40% close-to-midpoint variance fraction + 40% inverted body-to-range + 20% OC variance/range variance; gates trust in clustering/Hurst/vol when noise>P75 (0.63 on NQ). Empirically nearly orthogonal to realized vol (r≈0.159).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1, 602 NY sessions Jan 2024–Jun 2026 (mean enhanced noise≈0.604, SD≈0.053)
why_new_for_mis: Separates transient friction from information volatility so MIS can down-weight memory/vol sensors when bar structure is noisy even if vol is calm.
quote: the correlation between the enhanced noise ratio and realized vol from Part 4 is only 0.159 across 602 sessions. This non-redundancy is the empirical justification for computing both families of metrics.

mechanism: Live ASK−BID in points, else mean bar range as Parkinson/Garman–Klass-style execution-cost proxy; Roll-implied spread 2√max(0,−Cov(Δp_t,Δp_{t−1})) with |corr| confidence. On NQ M1 Roll≈0 (bounce absorbed by intrabar discovery); adverse_selection≈quoted_spread. OrderImbalance = volume-weighted (2·(C−L)/(H−L)−1).
data_needed: OHLCV + tick volume; optional live bid/ask; point size
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 futures (tick 0.25); retained for sub-minute / wider-spread instruments
why_new_for_mis: Provides a liquidity/cost sensor that remains informative when classic Roll fails at M1 aggregation, and documents when Roll confidence should zero the bounce estimate.
quote: The Roll-implied spread returns values approaching zero on NQ M1 data. This is the empirically correct result, not a bug. At one-minute resolution on a futures contract with hundreds of trades per bar

mechanism: OHLCV VPIN proxy: per-bar buy_vol=(C−L)/(H−L)·V, sell_vol complement; VPIN=mean|buy−sell|/mean total vol. Signed OrderFlowImbalance; TradeIntensity vs 20-session volume baseline; flow_confidence=0 if jump_intensity>P90 (2.1%), else reduced if noise>P75 (0.632). Explicitly not calibrated Easley VPIN.
data_needed: OHLCV + tick volume; Part 4 jump_intensity; Part 5 noise_ratio; 20-session vol baseline
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1, 602 sessions (VPIN range ~0.45–0.62; +6% in Apr 2025 tariff stress)
why_new_for_mis: Adds a toxicity/imbalance sensor whose reliability is explicitly gated by independent jump and noise sensors — usable as a liquidity-toxicity confidence channel for MIS.
quote: If jump_intensity exceeds the Part 4 90th percentile threshold (2.1%), flow_confidence is set to zero. If noise_ratio exceeds the Part 5 75th percentile threshold (0.632), flow_confidence is reduced proportionally.

mechanism: SmartMoneyIndex = (late_n − early_n) session log-return differential normalized by session range (default n_ends=15): positive = late accumulation after early selling. OrderFlowMomentum = short-window (10) minus long-window (30) signed flow — acceleration vs mean-reversion of pressure.
data_needed: Full-session OHLCV; calibrated n_ends for session length
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 NY session; BoJ shock median SMI negative; Apr 2026 tariff highest SMI (+0.147)
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an intraday informed-vs-noise timing sensor and a short-horizon flow acceleration sensor distinct from session-mean imbalance.
quote: A session where price falls early and then recovers late — positive SMI — suggests informed accumulation. A session where price rises early and then weakens late — negative SMI — suggests institutional distribution.

mechanism: Priority-ordered rules over Parts 2–6 metrics → {Stressed, Informed, Trending, Noisy, Mean-Reverting, Normal}. Stressed first (jump conf=0 or RV>P90 or RV>P75∧noise>P75); Informed needs VPIN>P75∧noise<P75∧clustering>median∧flow_conf>P25; Trending needs clustering>P75∧Δα<median∧noise clean; Mean-Reverting needs GPH d<P25∧clustering<P25. Confidence = rule score × √(MFDFA_R² × flow_confidence).
data_needed: Populated RobustFractalAnalysis, VolatilityAnalysis, MicrostructureAnalysis, OrderFlowAnalysis; NQ-calibrated percentile thresholds
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1, 514 sessions May 2024–May 2026 (50% Normal, 21% Stressed, 10% Noisy, 7% Informed, 7% Trending, 4% Mean-Reverting)
why_new_for_mis: Compresses an eleven-metric microstructure stack into a single transparent regime label with reliability — directly usable as MIS session-state ontology without opaque ML.
quote: RegimeClassifier() takes the outputs of Parts 2-6 and assigns one of six regime labels (Normal, Stressed, Noisy, Informed, Trending, Mean-Reverting).

mechanism: Signed composite_score in [−1,+1]: Trending/Informed follow MathSign(flow_imbalance)×conf; Mean-Reverting fades (−sign); Stressed/Noisy forced to 0; Normal weak 0.05×sign×flow_conf. Maps regime identity into an actionable directional stance and size multiplier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 514 sessions (Trending mean composite 0.356; Informed 0.270; Mean-Reverting −0.202)
why_new_for_mis: Converts static regime labels into a continuous directional change/stance sensor that zeros itself under adverse microstructure — a clean MIS actuation prior.
quote: For Trending and Informed sessions, the sign follows the flow imbalance direction and the magnitude reflects the confidence. For Mean-Reverting sessions, the sign is the opposite of the flow imbalance

mechanism: Bar-level score in [−1,+1]: 0.40 EMA 5/8/13 pairwise alignment + 0.40 tanh ATR-normalized price-vs-EMA position + 0.20 consistent 5-bar slope/(3·ATR), times volume boost clip[0.5,1.5] vs 20-bar avg; multiply by 0.3 contradiction penalty when alignment disagrees with price vs fast EMA. Maps to 7-state TREND_LABEL, binary ±1, and N-bar persistence.
data_needed: EMA handles 5/8/13, ATR(14), tick volume, close
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 NY sessions, 514 sessions May 2024–May 2026; MicroTrendStrength.mq5 indicator
why_new_for_mis: Supplies a continuous short-horizon trend-quality sensor (alignment×extension×slope×volume with contradiction dampening) that complements session-horizon regime labels.
quote: Rather than asking "has the fast EMA crossed the slow EMA," it asks "how strongly does the current EMA structure, price position, slope, and volume support a directional conclusion?"

mechanism: Scale micro-trend strong/weak cutoffs by Part 7 RegimeAnalysis.confidence: threshold_high = clamp(0.70 − 0.15·conf), threshold_low = clamp(0.30 − 0.10·conf). High-confidence Trending/Informed loosen firing; low-confidence Stressed/Noisy tighten. Empirically moves ~signals: Trending +6.5pp strong-signal rate, Stressed −1.8pp vs fixed 0.70/0.30.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1, same 514-session merge with Part 7 labels
why_new_for_mis: First explicit cross-layer sensing in the series: session regime confidence modulates bar-level signal sensitivity — a template for MIS hierarchical sensors.
quote: When a RegimeAnalysis struct is available, the strong- and weak-signal cutoffs are scaled by reg.confidence. High-confidence sessions (Trending, Informed) loosen thresholds so signals fire more readily. Low-confidence sessions (Stressed, Noisy) tighten them.

mechanism: Part 1 only scaffolds EasyAndFastGUI application structure (symbol/timeframe selection steps, signal display blocks, file layout). No market sensing algorithm is implemented yet — indicator rules are deferred.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 Market Watch symbols/timeframes (UI only)
why_new_for_mis: After full read: language/UI framework tutorial with no regime, vol, liquidity, or neural sensing content.
